labels.symptom: Spell check only supports US English, so words in other languages are flagged as misspelled.
labels.root_cause: The proofing engine has a hardcoded embedded en-US dictionary.

labels.symptom: There is no cloud service for sharing fonts, stock images, presets and project files.
The installer stops with 'a newer version is installed' because another installed Craft app is in the way.
labels.root_cause: Windows installers share the same upgrade code or product identity across apps.

labels.symptom: The product website link in the README and the MCP metadata leads to a 404 page.
labels.root_cause: The product page URL on getartcraft.com is missing.

labels.symptom: Changing the font makes the program freeze.
On KDE, text looks blurry except at certain zoom levels, and dragging the zoom slider makes it jitter.
labels.root_cause: Probably text is not snapped to the pixel grid when the scale is fractional.

labels.symptom: Inserted shapes cannot be moved or resized.
Text looks blurry compared with native apps, and there is no full print dialog.
Page margins and comments in the margin are not supported the way the original app supports them.
Exporting to a non-editable format such as PDF, PNG or TXT clears the unsaved-changes indicator even though the document was never saved.
labels.root_cause: The export path marks the document as clean, as if it had been saved.

labels.symptom: On Windows with Intel UHD Graphics the app crashes at startup with an access violation in igvk64.dll.
labels.root_cause: wgpu enumerates Vulkan adapters and the Intel Vulkan driver crashes; there is no fallback to DX12.

labels.symptom: In the portable build, changing a paragraph style freezes the app.
AutoSave is always on for saved documents, so every edit overwrites the original file even when it was only opened to look at.
labels.root_cause: AutoSave is turned on by default for every document that has a file path, and there is no per-document opt-in or global setting.

labels.symptom: Opening another file silently replaces an edited document without asking to save, and its undo history is lost.
labels.root_cause: The Open action doesn't check for unsaved changes before replacing the document.

labels.symptom: Hebrew and other right-to-left text appears with its characters reversed, and paragraphs are still aligned left-to-right.
labels.root_cause: Text shaping doesn't apply the BiDi algorithm.

labels.symptom: Suggestion for a new app called Wincraft, with no description.
Arabic text appears reversed and some letters show as squares.
labels.root_cause: There is no right-to-left text shaping and Arabic glyphs are missing from the font.

labels.symptom: The Linux .deb install never says a new version is available and has no one-click update.
labels.root_cause: There is no update checker or updater for the .deb package.

labels.symptom: Arabic and Kurdish text shows as disconnected or wrong letters instead of properly shaped right-to-left script.
labels.root_cause: Text shaping for Arabic script (letter joining and bidi) is missing or incomplete.

labels.symptom: Hebrew and Arabic text renders left to right with words reversed, and right-to-left direction has no effect.
labels.root_cause: Text layout lacks the Unicode bidirectional algorithm and RTL paragraph direction.

labels.symptom: Table columns and rows cannot be resized by dragging.
Spell checking only supports English; other languages such as French can't be chosen.
Opening a document with 'Open With' from the OS shows an unsupported-format error, though File > Open works.
labels.root_cause: The app bundle's document type declarations or open-file event handling don't accept the format.

labels.symptom: On macOS, Chinese interface text shows as empty boxes or question marks.
labels.root_cause: No CJK fallback font is loaded for the UI on macOS.

labels.symptom: The app cannot easily be set as the default program for its document file types.
The text cursor is white and invisible on a white page, and changing the language has no effect.
labels.root_cause: The caret colour comes from the theme and does not contrast with the document background.

labels.symptom: On Linux, opening the font picker freezes the app.
labels.root_cause: Likely enumerating or loading all system fonts synchronously on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: There are no View > Window commands for arranging, side-by-side viewing, synchronous scrolling, or switching between windows.
Report filed by mistake after launching the wrong version.
The interface cannot be switched to another language.
labels.root_cause: No localization mechanism exists yet.

labels.symptom: Images in opened Word documents are misplaced and overlap the text.
Right-to-left tables and sections show left-to-right.
labels.root_cause: The w:bidiVisual and section w:bidi properties are not read, written or used in layout.

labels.symptom: Shape text boxes are missing the Text Direction, Align Text and Create/Break Link commands.
labels.root_cause: The shape text body model and DOCX read/write don't cover bodyPr vert, anchor or linked text boxes.

labels.symptom: There is no in-app guide for finding the command-line tool and setting up an agent's MCP connection.
Desktop installs have no documented, reliable way to run the command-line tool, and on macOS it is a separate download.
labels.root_cause: Packaging puts the CLI in different places on each platform or leaves it out, and its invocation is not documented.

labels.symptom: Pasting an image from the clipboard into the app does nothing.
There is no Templates and Add-ins dialog for attaching a template or copying styles.
Content controls in documents are removed on open, so form fields are lost on a round trip.
labels.root_cause: w:sdt content controls are unwrapped on import instead of being modelled.

labels.symptom: Footnote and endnote options cannot be set per section.
Only pictures can have alt text, objects cannot be marked decorative, and the accessibility checker knows only a few rules.
There is no .exe installer for Windows.
Documents cannot use a document grid for lines per page and characters per line, and East Asian line-break rules are not fully applied.
The Draw tab has no Lasso Select, Add Pen, Ink to Shape or Ink Replay.
British spellings are flagged as errors, and words added to the dictionary may not persist between sessions.
labels.root_cause: Only a US English dictionary is bundled, and the user word list is kept in memory only.

labels.symptom: Tracked moves are shown and saved as a plain insertion and deletion.
labels.root_cause: w:moveFrom/w:moveTo are read as delete/insert, so the link between source and destination is lost.

labels.symptom: The Caption, Index, Table of Contents and Source commands have no options dialogs.
There is no plugin system for third-party commands, UI and document access.
The Line Numbers, Hyphenation, Language, Envelopes and Labels options dialogs are missing.
Charts can't be inserted or edited in a document.
The Compare/Combine Documents, Restrict Editing and AutoCorrect Options dialogs are missing or incomplete.
There is no WordArt and no shape connectors.
With Track Changes on, Reject All leaves the paragraph breaks added by a paste.
labels.root_cause: Paragraph splits made by regular Paste are not recorded as tracked changes.

labels.symptom: Centering a selected paragraph also centers the next paragraph.
labels.root_cause: Paragraph formatting includes the paragraph where the selection ends, even when the selection ends at its start.

labels.symptom: Undoing a typed replacement of selected text also undoes the typing that came before it.
labels.root_cause: Selecting text does not close the open typing undo group, so the replacement is merged into it.

labels.symptom: Section breaks in DOCX files don't appear when formatting marks are shown.
After changing the case of Unicode text, the selection covers the wrong characters.
labels.root_cause: Selection offsets are not adjusted when case conversion changes the UTF-8 byte length.

labels.symptom: Changing the case of mixed-format text removes bold from characters whose case did not change.
labels.root_cause: Case conversion that changes text length rebuilds runs and loses character formatting.

labels.symptom: Pasting plain text with a blank line into a bullet list item drops the empty paragraph.
Replace All with a replacement containing a paragraph break keeps the text in a single paragraph.
labels.root_cause: Replace All inserts the replacement as raw text instead of splitting paragraphs the way single Replace does.

labels.symptom: After undoing Bold in an empty paragraph, newly typed text is still bold.
labels.root_cause: Undo restores the document but not the pending caret typing format.

labels.symptom: Table of contents always includes three heading levels regardless of the requested depth.
labels.root_cause: TOC generation ignores the stored level range and falls back to a default of three.

labels.symptom: Refreshing fields adds headings to a table of figures and duplicates caption entries.
labels.root_cause: General field update regenerates a table of figures as a heading TOC without caption filtering.

labels.symptom: Delete Columns removes only one column when several columns are selected.
labels.root_cause: The command uses only the selection focus column.

labels.symptom: Splitting one table cell also adds an empty cell to an unselected row.
labels.root_cause: Split Cells modifies the table grid instead of dividing only the target cell.

labels.symptom: Footnotes referenced from table cells are missing from PDF output though the reference number shows.
labels.root_cause: Footnote collection during layout skips references inside table cells.

labels.symptom: Total page count fields in body text show 1 in multi-page documents while footers show the correct total.
labels.root_cause: NUMPAGES and SECTIONPAGES in body paragraphs are evaluated before pagination totals are known.

labels.symptom: With mirrored margins, even pages keep body text at the inside margin instead of swapping sides.
labels.root_cause: Layout ignores mirrored margins when computing even-page left margin.

labels.symptom: A tall footer overlaps the last body lines of the page in PDF export.
labels.root_cause: Layout does not reserve body space for footers taller than the bottom margin.

labels.symptom: An inherited tall header overlaps the first body line of the next section in PDF export.
labels.root_cause: Body reservation for tall headers ignores headers linked from the previous section.

labels.symptom: Internal bookmark links in exported PDFs jump to the page before the target when the paragraph spans a page break.
labels.root_cause: PDF destinations use the paragraph's first fragment page instead of the bookmark's offset page.

labels.symptom: A long endnote is cut off in PDF export because it isn't continued onto more pages.
labels.root_cause: Endnote layout places the whole note on one page without paginating overflow.

labels.symptom: The caret disappears in a footnote continued across pages and pressing Up jumps to the start of the note.
labels.root_cause: Caret geometry lookup uses the last targeted page instead of the page containing the offset.

labels.symptom: A bookmark wrapping the document's final table loses its end on import, and saving writes an unmatched bookmark start.
labels.root_cause: DOCX import drops a bookmark end that follows the final table with no following paragraph.

labels.symptom: Opening and saving a DOCX drops the picture cached inside an INCLUDEPICTURE field.
labels.root_cause: DOCX import/export does not preserve drawing results inside INCLUDEPICTURE fields.

labels.symptom: Changing only font size in the Font dialog removes small caps, all caps, hidden, character spacing and special underline styles.
labels.root_cause: The Font dialog applies all character properties rather than only edited ones.

labels.symptom: Accepting the Paragraph dialog without touching line spacing resets Exactly or At Least spacing to Single.
labels.root_cause: The dialog's accept path always writes a multiple line-spacing value instead of only changed properties.

labels.symptom: Find Next skips every other match, so repeated searches select only alternate occurrences.
labels.root_cause: The Find Next action advances the search position twice per action.

labels.symptom: Converting a footnote citation to in-text removes a picture that was the footnote's only other content.
labels.root_cause: Note conversion treats a note with only the citation and a picture as citation-only and deletes it.

labels.symptom: The app won't start and files won't open.
A pending reference-manager citation is inserted into a newly created document instead of the original one, adding an undo step there.
labels.root_cause: The citation bridge accepts delayed calls from an old operation against a replacement document without validating the document handle.

labels.symptom: The Page Setup dialog launcher in the ribbon does nothing when clicked.
labels.root_cause: The launcher action is not wired to open the existing Page Setup dialog.

labels.symptom: Dropping a TXT document after picking a CSV recipient list replaces the recipients instead of opening the document.
labels.root_cause: The recipient-picker state stays set after the picker finishes, so the next drop is treated as a recipient list.

labels.symptom: Refreshing a one-entry table of contents after reopening the DOCX keeps the old entry and adds a duplicate.
labels.root_cause: A reopened single-entry DOCX TOC is not fully replaced when it is regenerated.

labels.symptom: Right-to-left languages such as Persian cannot be typed or laid out correctly.
labels.root_cause: Text shaping does not support bidirectional or RTL layout.

labels.symptom: The Options dialog is one short page and lacks the settings panes people expect.
Screen readers cannot read or follow the document text because the canvas is one opaque widget.
labels.root_cause: The custom canvas widget exposes no AccessKit nodes for its content.

labels.symptom: Sections cannot use vertical text direction.
labels.root_cause: Section text direction is not modelled or laid out.

labels.symptom: Outline view has no outline levels, collapse/expand, or Outlining tab.
SmartArt graphics cannot be created or edited.
Spelling and grammar proofing is available only for US English, not Indonesian.
The font picker lists no Chinese fonts.
The README doesn't say which of several Arch AUR packages to install.
Installing one app's Windows MSI removes, or is blocked by, another installed app from the suite.
labels.root_cause: Several apps' MSI installers share the same ProductCode/UpgradeCode.

labels.symptom: The paragraph spacing dialog lacks Mirror indents, Don't add space between same-style paragraphs, Suppress line numbers and Don't hyphenate options.
Right-clicking an image offers no Wrap Text option.
There is no opt-in way to back up, version or share documents on storage the user owns (NAS, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 via rclone).
On Windows and Linux the window lacks the standard custom title bar and caption buttons, and there is no System Title Bar preference.
labels.root_cause: Window decoration handling not standardized to the shared custom title bar architecture.

labels.symptom: The macOS app shipped in the DMG fails strict codesign verification because of FinderInfo metadata.
labels.root_cause: The macOS packaging script leaves a com.apple.FinderInfo extended attribute on the signed app bundle.

labels.symptom: Tables set to right-to-left still render left-to-right, and there is no Table Properties dialog to change the setting.
labels.root_cause: The table layout ignores the RTL table property.

labels.symptom: After installing with the Windows installer, typed text never appears and no cursor shows, but the portable build works.
In documents with Chinese text the original fonts are replaced, tables overlap, indentation shifts and extra blank pages appear.
The floating text-format toolbar is cut off, its font list has a white background in dark mode, and its dropdown arrows look like dots.
On Linux the window header stays black even when the light theme is selected.
Find and Replace treats special codes like ^p literally and has no wildcard mode.
AutoCorrect does not fix two initial capitals, accidental Caps Lock, or the first letter of table cells.
AutoFormat As You Type misses ASCII tables, arrow bullets, smileys inside words, and undo after border lines.
Word XML (Flat OPC) and Word 2003 XML documents cannot be opened or saved.
Double- or triple-click and drag does not extend the selection by whole words or paragraphs.
Pictures and shapes are missing from imported .doc files.
labels.root_cause: The docbin reader skips OfficeArt and picture records.

labels.symptom: Character spacing is applied to text, but the Font dialog shows 0.0 when reopened.
labels.root_cause: The spacing value is not stored in the run properties that the Font dialog reads.

labels.symptom: Very large documents with many pictures and tables may become slow to edit and scroll.
labels.root_cause: Performance on large documents has never been measured or optimised.

labels.symptom: Choosing 'Update to match selection' on a heading style does not update the style.
The interface cannot be switched to other languages such as Arabic.
On Linux with an IBus input method, Bengali text being composed shows as empty square boxes in the preedit area, though the committed text is correct.
labels.root_cause: The font used to draw IME preedit text has no Bengali glyphs and does not fall back to a font that does.

labels.symptom: M3U playlist files open with wrong content or no content.
There is no real-time spelling and grammar checking.
On some Wayland Linux setups the file dialog never appears, so files cannot be opened, saved or imported.
Web users can't add their own fonts from a link or a file; only fonts bundled at build time are available.
labels.root_cause: The web build has no runtime font loading.

labels.symptom: Paste from the ribbon or the right-click menu does nothing with text copied from other apps, while Ctrl+V works.
labels.root_cause: The menu Paste command reads only the app's internal clipboard, not the system clipboard.

labels.symptom: The interface feels stiff because it has no smooth animations.
Comments in a document are left out when it is printed, exported or converted.
The app freezes when changing the font of selected Thai text.
labels.root_cause: Probably a hang in font fallback or text shaping for Thai script.

labels.symptom: The project website link returns a 404 error.
Some interface text shows in English in every language because the strings are missing from the translation catalogs.
labels.root_cause: Strings wrapped in tl! have no entries in any catalog.

labels.symptom: Text inside an equation cannot be selected with the mouse or with Shift+Arrow.
Drawn strokes appear on the canvas about 50 ms late and menu hover highlights lag.
labels.root_cause: Latency in the shared render/present pipeline.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app exits right after the window appears with 'Parent device is lost' because the DXC shader compiler DLLs are missing.
labels.root_cause: Windows packages do not ship dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll, so wgpu's DX12 DXC pipeline compile fails and the device is lost.

labels.symptom: Myanmar (Burmese) and other complex-script text is not shaped correctly when typed.
labels.root_cause: Text rendering lacks complex script shaping for scripts like Myanmar.

labels.symptom: Documents with many different characters that no loaded font covers freeze the app for a long time.
labels.root_cause: For each such character, system font fallback re-reads and parses every system font file from disk.

labels.symptom: The text color picker offers only preset colors, with no custom color or hex input.
Diagrams embedded in DOCX files render with missing lines, and callout text is displaced from its shape.
On Linux, printing and export don't work.
Quick-access functions can't be added to the top menu.
Right-to-left tables in imported DOCX files show their columns in reversed order.
labels.root_cause: The DOCX importer ignores the w:bidiVisual table property.

labels.symptom: No Microsoft 365 sign-in through the Himmelblau token DBus service.
There is no compact single-line ribbon layout.
Pressing Alt does not show KeyTips for navigating the ribbon by keyboard.
Arabic text does not display correctly.
labels.root_cause: Probably missing right-to-left text shaping or fallback fonts in the UI text stack.

labels.symptom: On small phone screens the window content does not fit, even in landscape.
labels.root_cause: The layout is not responsive to very small screen sizes.

labels.symptom: An inserted table has no move handle, so it can't be selected as a whole or dragged.
labels.root_cause: The table move/select handle is not implemented.

labels.symptom: A ribbon gallery overlaps the neighbouring buttons, cutting off their labels.
The installer refuses to run because it says a newer version is already installed, even on a machine that never had the app.
labels.root_cause: Probably an installer upgrade or product code clash, for example a shared code across apps or a leftover registry entry.

labels.symptom: Vertically merged table cells still show a gridline and act as two separate cells when clicked.
labels.root_cause: layout_table places a separate cell for each vertical-merge continuation row instead of one spanning cell.

labels.symptom: The Print page has no print settings (page range, copies, printer, duplex) and no preview; printing hands the document to another viewer.
labels.root_cause: Printing goes through an external viewer instead of a built-in print dialog.

labels.symptom: The bulleted list toolbar button is not highlighted when the cursor is inside a list item.
On older Intel Macs with only Metal 2 support, the app quits right after launch with a shader compile error or a surface creation error.
labels.root_cause: Shaders are compiled with the metal3.2 standard, which older GPUs reject, and the GL backend fallback can't create a surface on macOS.

labels.symptom: There is no normal view that hides the whitespace between pages.
Opening a second document hides the first one, and only one document can be used per session.
There is no browser-based or cloud-hosted version.
Two-line labels on large ribbon buttons overlap the group title text below them.
labels.root_cause: Ribbon button layout puts the icon and label offsets too low, so a second label line runs past the content height into the title row.

labels.symptom: Paragraph fields on the ribbon's layout tab overlap the group title and are misaligned.
In the dark theme, white text and controls on the accent colour have too little contrast.
labels.root_cause: The dark accent is too light for white content, and filled controls use Color32::WHITE instead of on_accent.

labels.symptom: Some interface colours, such as dialog buttons and the search highlight, ignore the dark theme.
labels.root_cause: Some colours are hard-coded instead of coming from theme tokens.

labels.symptom: Text field and combo box borders are too faint, below 3:1 contrast in both light and dark themes.
labels.root_cause: The theme's input_border colour is too close to the background.

labels.symptom: Disabled ribbon menu buttons never grey out.
labels.root_cause: The menu button widget has no enabled flag or command id, so it always draws in enabled colours.

labels.symptom: Ribbon buttons show two different dropdown markers that differ in size, weight and position.
labels.root_cause: Some buttons append a text glyph while others draw the dropdown icon.

labels.symptom: Arabic and right-to-left text and interface layout are not fully supported.
labels.root_cause: No bidirectional text shaping or RTL layout support.

labels.symptom: Some icons are drawn at off-grid sizes and look blurry.
labels.root_cause: Some call sites paint icons at sizes other than 16 or 32 px.

labels.symptom: A ribbon button is icon-only and has no label, unlike the matching button next to it.
At common window widths the ribbon tab overflows and its last groups are cut off behind a scroll chevron.
labels.root_cause: Ribbon groups do not collapse to smaller layouts as the window narrows.

labels.symptom: In the dark theme the style preview tiles are bright white.
The brand licence text names a different app from the repository it ships in.
labels.root_cause: The brand licence file was copied from a sibling repo without changing the app name.

labels.symptom: Building the docs with warnings treated as errors fails because a doc comment links to a private constant.
labels.root_cause: A public field's doc comment uses an intra-doc link to the private REGION_LABELS constant.

labels.symptom: On macOS, documents set in Palatino Linotype or Book Antiqua render in Times New Roman, which changes the layout and page count.
labels.root_cause: The font substitution table maps Palatino Linotype to the generic serif list instead of trying Palatino first, and the font scan skips the Office font folder.

labels.symptom: Automation render and screenshot commands write to fixed file names in the shared temp folder, so another local user can make them overwrite the user's files through a symlink.
labels.root_cause: The control server writes to fixed paths in /tmp with std::fs::write, which follows symlinks.

labels.symptom: Exporting to HTML or Markdown keeps javascript: links, which run script when clicked.
labels.root_cause: The exporters write link targets into href without checking the URL scheme.

labels.symptom: On Linux at 100% scaling, the interface looks too small and the text is not antialiased.
Voice typing does not work.
Cannot insert a chart whose data comes from an embedded spreadsheet workbook.
labels.root_cause: The chart insert path leaves out the externalData embedded workbook part.

labels.symptom: Clicking a toolbar button takes focus away from the document so the cursor disappears and typing stops.
labels.root_cause: Toolbar buttons take keyboard focus and do not give it back to the editor.

labels.symptom: Pasting text copied from other apps loses formatting and Paste Special reports the clipboard is empty.
labels.root_cause: Clipboard access reads only plain text and ignores rich formats like HTML/RTF.

labels.symptom: Selecting text by dragging past the visible area does not auto-scroll the view.
Save As does not save under a different filename; only the folder can be changed.
There is no option to show formatting marks such as tabs and line breaks.
The Windows installer refuses to install, saying a newer version is already installed, when other suite apps are already installed.
labels.root_cause: The installers probably share the same upgrade/product code across apps.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app freezes for good when the font selector dropdown is opened.
On GNOME Wayland the window title bar is a plain fallback bar that ignores the desktop theme, dark mode and button layout.
labels.root_cause: eframe with default-features=false drops winit's wayland-csd-adwaita feature, so sctk-adwaita is not built.

labels.symptom: VBA macros are not supported.
Inserted images cannot be moved or resized in the document.
Pressing Enter or Backspace doesn't exit a bullet list.
In PDF export, cross-reference fields show a replacement character instead of their text.
labels.root_cause: The PDF renderer doesn't output the cached result of REF fields.

labels.symptom: TIFF images show as grey boxes, and drawing a faded image crashes the app.
labels.root_cause: The image crate was built without its tiff feature, and vello_cpu 0.2 panics on image paints whose alpha is below 1.

labels.symptom: The Windows MSI refuses to install, saying a newer version is already installed, when a different Craft app is installed.
labels.root_cause: The WiX installer reused another Craft app's UpgradeCode and component GUID.

labels.symptom: Line breaks placed directly in a DOCX paragraph are dropped, so text runs together.
labels.root_cause: The reader ignored w:br and w:cr outside runs.

labels.symptom: Borderless HTML tables are imported with grid borders on every cell.
labels.root_cause: Every imported table got the TableGrid style.

labels.symptom: Footnotes and endnotes from Word files show no number in the note text.
labels.root_cause: The reader skipped the w:footnoteRef and w:endnoteRef marks.

labels.symptom: Table rows come out much taller than in the original and table style text formatting is ignored.
labels.root_cause: Style resolution skipped the table style level and dropped the basedOn chain.

labels.symptom: Paragraph vertical spacing drifts from Word's layout over a page.
labels.root_cause: Space before/after was summed instead of collapsed, and borders and line spacing took no room.

labels.symptom: Justified paragraphs wrap onto more lines than in Word 2013 and later.
labels.root_cause: Spaces in justified lines were not shrunk the way compatibility mode 15 does, and the compatibility mode was not tracked.

labels.symptom: LaTeX files can't be opened or saved.
On macOS, text on the canvas looks lighter, thinner and blurrier than in other Mac apps.
labels.root_cause: There was no macOS-style stem darkening, and textures were drawn at fractional pixel positions.

labels.symptom: Imported documents show text in Times New Roman instead of the document's default font.
labels.root_cause: East Asian/complex-script rFonts attributes were used as the Latin font when ascii/hAnsi were missing, overriding docDefaults.

labels.symptom: When an HTML file is imported, images referenced by a relative path are dropped and only their alt text remains.
labels.root_cause: The HTML importer loaded images only from data: URIs.

labels.symptom: There is no Apply Styles command.
Releases are not versioned and drafted automatically.
The interface is English only and does not follow the system language.
labels.root_cause: No UI translation catalogs or system locale detection.

labels.symptom: There is no Flatpak repository that Linux users can add to install and update the app.
With the automation control port enabled, any local process can send commands to the app without authentication.
labels.root_cause: The control server accepted unauthenticated connections from any local process.

labels.symptom: A tracked deletion reassigns other authors' earlier deletions to the current user.
labels.root_cause: The tracked-delete logic overwrote existing deletion authorship.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Brazilian Portuguese.
Ribbon groups past the window edge are cut off with no sign they exist, and Spanish isn't offered.
labels.root_cause: The ribbon's scrollbar was hidden.

labels.symptom: Applying a heading or Title style to a list paragraph keeps its list numbering.
labels.root_cause: A redundant condition in apply_style made the heading/Title branches dead code.

labels.symptom: PDF export fails with 'failed to subset font: malformed font' when certain fonts are used.
labels.root_cause: krilla's subsetter rejects some fonts, and that failed the whole export.

labels.symptom: Text copied from exported PDFs shows placeholder characters instead of page numbers and note numbers.
labels.root_cause: Glyph runs took their text from the paragraph's U+FFFC placeholder instead of the shown text.

labels.symptom: Numbered lists in some documents show wrong labels, and the overrides are lost on save.
labels.root_cause: Full w:lvl definitions inside w:lvlOverride were ignored.

labels.symptom: With multiple line spacing, text sits slightly lower on the page than in Word.
labels.root_cause: The extra space from multiple line spacing was put above the text instead of below it.

labels.symptom: Floating pictures and shapes land in the wrong place, or don't appear in headers, footers and table cells.
labels.root_cause: The reader collapsed anchor references, ignored wp:align, and floats outside the body weren't laid out.

labels.symptom: Tables sit too far left, and floating tables are laid out inline with the text.
labels.root_cause: The compatibility mode was ignored and tblpPr wasn't supported.

labels.symptom: Lines holding pictures, the body start under a tall header, and table row heights come out at the wrong size, so text sits in the wrong place.
labels.root_cause: Picture lines dropped the font ascent and descent, multiple line spacing scaled the picture too, a 6pt gap was added below the header, and at-least row heights left out cell margins and borders.

labels.symptom: The app is not listed in the Omarchy app catalog.
labels.root_cause: There is no omastore.toml manifest.

labels.symptom: Opening a Word 97-2003 .doc file gives an empty document.
labels.root_cause: There was no reader for the legacy binary Word format.

labels.symptom: Table grid lines are invisible when the borders come from the table style.
labels.root_cause: An empty tblBorders element replaced the style's borders as a whole instead of being merged side by side.

labels.symptom: Inserted pictures can't be edited because there is no picture formatting UI.
labels.root_cause: The engine's picture commands were never wired to the UI.

labels.symptom: New, Open, Close or quitting discard unsaved changes without asking, and AutoSave rewrites files that were only opened.
labels.root_cause: Document replacement and window close never checked the dirty state, and AutoSave was on for every opened file.

labels.symptom: Find/Replace matches text that was deleted under Track Changes, and a failed command loses redo history.
labels.root_cause: Search included deleted runs, and the session cleared redo history on a failed command.

labels.symptom: Imported HTML without </head> comes out empty, and pictures in Word-written RTF are lost.
labels.root_cause: The body was parsed as head content, and the shppict destination was skipped.

labels.symptom: On Windows 11 with fractional display scaling the window opens at the wrong physical size.
labels.root_cause: Unpatched winit 0.30.13 computes physical window size incorrectly under Windows 11 fractional DPI scaling (upstream winit #4341).

labels.symptom: On Wayland, typing or IME composition is interrupted when the compositor changes text-input capabilities.
labels.root_cause: winit dropped the Wayland text-input object when compositor capabilities changed.

labels.symptom: On Windows, the IME caret appears in the wrong position during composition, especially when typing Korean.
labels.root_cause: winit's Windows IME path does not carry the composition caret position through.

labels.symptom: On Windows, a window that should start hidden flashes into view while it is being maximized.
labels.root_cause: winit makes the window visible when it applies the maximized state.

labels.symptom: On Linux X11, the input method stops working after the input context is replaced.
labels.root_cause: winit leaves its focus handling bound to the old X11 input context.

labels.symptom: There are no instructions for installing on Gentoo.
On macOS, text committed with an input method sometimes disappears and never reaches the field.
labels.root_cause: winit drops the pending IME commit when the marked text is cleared.

labels.symptom: On macOS, IME text can appear in the wrong place after focus moves.
labels.root_cause: winit applies delayed composition callbacks after focus or IME state has already changed.

labels.symptom: On macOS, emoji picked from the emoji picker never show up in text fields.
labels.root_cause: winit doesn't forward text inserted by the emoji picker to the app's event stream.

labels.symptom: On macOS, typing a space during Korean input inserts two spaces.
labels.root_cause: Both the native winit IME callback and the app's text handling insert the space.

labels.symptom: On macOS the first Korean key pressed after startup comes out as a raw jamo instead of starting composition.
labels.root_cause: winit's macOS backend does not route the first Apple Korean keystroke into IME composition.

labels.symptom: At fractional zoom levels the page looks blurry or is off by one pixel from its outline.
labels.root_cause: Raster origins and sizes weren't snapped to physical pixel boundaries.

labels.symptom: The command-line tool ignores or misreads unknown options after it has already started work on files.
labels.root_cause: Long options were not checked before side effects.

labels.symptom: Warnings and errors are never written anywhere, so there is no log to attach to a bug report.
labels.root_cause: The desktop app never installs a logger or panic hook, so log records are discarded.

labels.symptom: Mail-merge style commands replace the open document and lose unsaved work without asking.
labels.root_cause: The commands call set_document, which replaces the document and resets history with no save prompt.

labels.symptom: Saving a macro-enabled document deletes its macros, and template files are saved with the wrong content type.
labels.root_cause: The writer always produced a plain .docx package and dropped VBA parts.

labels.symptom: Hidden text that isn't shown still changes line breaks and hyphenation, and its floating objects still push text aside.
labels.root_cause: Break opportunities and wrap areas were computed from the full paragraph text instead of the laid-out text.

labels.symptom: The web hosting guide advertises a ?cpu renderer flag that does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The docs listed a CPU canvas path that was never implemented.

labels.symptom: There is no way to invite AI agents into a chat pane that can read and edit the open document.
Ctrl/Cmd + mouse wheel or trackpad pinch over the document does not zoom.
labels.root_cause: The canvas never read egui's zoom_delta, so zoom gestures were ignored.

labels.symptom: The app keeps redrawing at the monitor refresh rate and uses CPU/GPU while idle.
labels.root_cause: ViewportCommand::Title was sent every frame, and each viewport command requests a repaint.

labels.symptom: There is no Zotero citation integration, and citation fields get flattened to plain text.
Read Aloud has no player for pausing, skipping sentences or changing speed, and it reads citations out loud.
Equations are flattened to plain text and cannot be edited.
In dark mode the document page stays bright white.
Long style names run into neighbouring gallery tiles, and hanging-indent previews are cut off on the left.
labels.root_cause: Labels were painted at full width, and the preview did not allow for a hanging indent larger than the left indent.

labels.symptom: There is no Hebrew interface and no right-to-left layout.
The interface is not available in German.
Pressing Enter after leaving a list does nothing and the list indent sticks to later paragraphs; AutoFormat and AutoCorrect differ from Word.
labels.root_cause: Leaving a list set num 0 but kept the List Paragraph style, which the empty-list check still treated as a list item.

labels.symptom: Right-to-left text such as Persian or Arabic is not reordered or shaped correctly.
labels.root_cause: Text layout lacked bidi reordering and complex-script shaping.

labels.symptom: In the browser build you can export but not print directly to the system print dialog.
The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window.
labels.root_cause: The DMG had no background or icon layout.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Norwegian Nynorsk, and Nynorsk system locales are not recognised.
In the browser build, new items are stamped with a fixed date of 2026-01-01 instead of the current time.
labels.root_cause: The wasm32 branch of the timestamp helper returned a hardcoded string because SystemTime::now panics on wasm.

labels.symptom: No Flatpak release builds are published, AppImages cannot update themselves, and FreeBSD builds lack bundled fonts.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow lacked Flatpak jobs, zsync update info, and craft-fonts in the FreeBSD build.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland desktops, dragging files from the file manager onto the window shows a prohibited cursor and nothing is dropped.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 does not implement drag-and-drop on Wayland, so the app has to run through XWayland.

labels.symptom: A keyboard shortcut runs a different command than expected because two commands share the same key.
labels.root_cause: Two commands registered the same shortcut and the lookup returns the first match.

labels.symptom: On macOS, double-clicking a document in Finder, dropping it on the Dock or using open -a launches the app without opening the file.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 does not handle the kAEOpenDocuments Apple event that LaunchServices sends.

labels.symptom: Scripts cannot set the author name of tracked changes in headless mode.
Cross-references point at nothing and cannot be refreshed by Update Field.
labels.root_cause: Fields used a literal _Ref bookmark name without creating a bookmark.

labels.symptom: Shapes and pictures cannot be moved or resized.
In the browser, timers never fire, the caret doesn't blink, and dates are wrong.
labels.root_cause: Clock helpers were stubs that returned 0 on wasm instead of reading the browser clock.

labels.symptom: Zoom In jumps to a lower zoom when a fit-to-width or fit-page mode is active.
labels.root_cause: Zoom steps used a stale stored manual zoom instead of the shown fit zoom.

labels.symptom: Opening the font picker freezes the app, and text in scripts that need fallback fonts gets slow.
labels.root_cause: The font list built a preview row for every installed font, and each fallback-font lookup sorted all loaded faces with no cache.

labels.symptom: Find cannot list every match, highlight all matches, or search within a selection.
There is no Paste Special to paste clipboard content as RTF, HTML or plain text.
There is no Style Inspector pane to see and clear paragraph and character formatting levels.
There is no way to select a rectangular block of text with Alt+drag.
Adds a contributor entry.
The font list shows only Regular, Bold and Italic, with no Light, Medium or other installed weights.
labels.root_cause: Fonts were listed and matched only by typographic family name (name ID 16), ignoring the legacy family name (name ID 1).

labels.symptom: An absolutely positioned text box in a document header pushes the body text down and inflates the page count.
labels.root_cause: The VML reader ignored position:absolute and always treated shapes as inline.

labels.symptom: Ticking the View Gridlines checkbox does nothing on pages without tables.
labels.root_cause: The gridlines command only outlined table cells and was shared with the table gridlines button.

labels.symptom: Reject All leaves paragraph breaks that were inserted with Track Changes on.
labels.root_cause: Accepting or rejecting a tracked paragraph mark only cleared the flag and did not join the paragraphs.

labels.symptom: The table Text Direction button has no visible effect on cell text.
labels.root_cause: Layout and rendering never read the cell's vertical-text flag.

labels.symptom: On Linux, opening Open, Save As or Export freezes the window, and the dialog can appear behind it.
labels.root_cause: A blocking rfd FileDialog with no parent window ran on the UI thread, which stalled the event loop on the xdg-desktop-portal D-Bus call.

labels.symptom: Clicking Select Recipients only shows a missing-parameters error and no dialog or file picker opens.
labels.root_cause: The ribbon ran the recipients command with no parameters and had no input dialog to fall back on.

labels.symptom: With the Simplified Chinese interface, some menu and button characters show as boxes while document text looks fine.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow pinned a craft-fonts commit from before Noto Sans CJK SC was added, so no Simplified Chinese UI font was embedded.

labels.symptom: The interface does not follow the OS light/dark appearance and has no System theme option.
labels.root_cause: The theme was a boolean dark flag, and egui's own theme preference was not pinned, so an OS appearance change swapped in unstyled egui visuals.

labels.symptom: Serbian (Cyrillic and Latin) is not available as an interface language.
labels.root_cause: No Serbian catalogs registered.

labels.symptom: When zoomed out, pages stay in a single column instead of filling rows side by side.
On Wayland, touchpad scrolling feels choppy, has no inertia after a flick, and mouse wheel scrolls too little.
labels.root_cause: egui's ScrollArea drops Start/End phase deltas from winit and no kinetic scrolling is synthesised; default wheel step is 40 px.

labels.symptom: The File menu's Home and New pages show the same content.
On macOS the window buttons are not vertically centred in the title bar and crowd nearby buttons.
labels.root_cause: The custom title bar was 38 pt tall while AppKit centres the window buttons in a 28 pt band.

labels.symptom: Custom table styles cannot be created or kept in saved documents.
The Windows MSI installer closes without showing a finish or success page.
labels.root_cause: The WiX source had no UI element.

labels.symptom: Desktop users are never told when a new version is released.
labels.root_cause: The app had no update check.

labels.symptom: Mail merge ribbon buttons do nothing visible.
The Linux package description names a different app, and the README Downloads section is out of order.
labels.root_cause: nfpm.yaml was copied from another app and never updated.

labels.symptom: Exported PDF text is scrambled when the font joins letters into ligatures, and tests fail on machines with different system fonts.
labels.root_cause: Each glyph was mapped to one character, so ligature glyphs lost letters, and tests relied on installed system fonts.

labels.symptom: Table styles cannot format every table region, have no live preview and cannot be deleted.
There is no clipboard pane showing recently copied items to paste again.
Pictures, shapes and text boxes cannot be grouped or ungrouped.
Document properties typed in File Info are lost, and browser saves keep stale revision and modified dates.
labels.root_cause: Field edits went to a copy that was rebuilt every frame, and the browser save path skipped the metadata stamping.

labels.symptom: There is no Manage Styles dialog for listing, previewing, deleting or hiding styles.
There are no Asian typography paragraph options such as kinsoku line breaking.
Pasting an image from the system clipboard says the clipboard is empty.
labels.root_cause: egui's paste event only carries text, and egui-winit drops Ctrl+V when the clipboard holds only an image.

labels.symptom: Some interface labels and tooltips stay in English when another language is selected.
labels.root_cause: Strings wrapped in tl! had no rows in the translation catalogs.

labels.symptom: The progress and parity docs are out of date.
With formatting marks shown, the paragraph mark is drawn over a letter in mixed-direction paragraphs.
labels.root_cause: The mark was placed at the logical end of the line instead of the visual end.

labels.symptom: Shapes cannot have shadow, glow or soft-edge effects.
Opening a password-protected document shows a blank document and there is no way to save with a password.
labels.root_cause: Office encryption (MS-OFFCRYPTO agile) was not implemented.

labels.symptom: On Linux X11 every window shows two title bars, with the window controls only on the system one.
labels.root_cause: The system window frame stays on while the app draws its own title bar.

labels.symptom: Gridlines ignore the document's own grid spacing, and tables without borders don't show cell gridlines by default.
A layout test fails on FreeBSD CI because the expected numbers depend on which fonts are installed.
labels.root_cause: The test expected a layout height that only holds with common system fonts and fails when only the bundled fonts are present.

labels.symptom: File › Print on desktop only offers export, with no way to print.
labels.root_cause: The desktop build had no print route.

labels.symptom: There are no Height/Width boxes or Table Properties dialog for tables, and AutoFit to Contents does not fit columns to their text.
Comments can't be edited in their balloons, and page margins can't be dragged on the ruler.
Autofit tables don't size their columns to their content, and floating tables inside cells aren't laid out.
Charts and SmartArt in imported documents are dropped, so the text after them moves up.
labels.root_cause: The importer had no support for chart and diagram parts.

labels.symptom: WMF and EMF pictures show as grey boxes instead of their content.
labels.root_cause: There was no decoder for Windows metafiles.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Estonian.
labels.root_cause: No Estonian translation catalogue existed.

labels.symptom: Cannot add ruby text (furigana, pinyin) over text, and ruby in DOCX files is dropped.
labels.root_cause: No ruby inline object in the model, layout or DOCX reader/writer.

labels.symptom: On Linux, the 'Use system setting' theme option always shows the light theme, even when the desktop is dark.
labels.root_cause: winit's system_theme() always returns None on Linux, so the theme falls back to light.

labels.symptom: Sibling-app references still use the old name PrintCraft instead of PdfCraft.
The interface is not available in Russian.
There is no way to enclose a character in a circle, square, triangle or diamond.
The AutoSave switch shows as on even when the document can't be autosaved, so edits go unsaved without any explanation.
labels.root_cause: The switch checked only whether the file was saved in this session, not the browser case or the file format.

labels.symptom: Documents can't be opened from the file manager or set to open with the app by default, because the app doesn't register itself for its file types.
labels.root_cause: Installers and desktop files did not declare file type associations.

labels.symptom: Some buttons show empty boxes instead of symbols such as the close X or pencil.
labels.root_cause: The UI strings used symbol characters that the interface fonts (Inter plus egui's emoji fallbacks) don't contain.

labels.symptom: You can't draw tables or split and merge cells with a pen and eraser.
On Linux X11 the app looks zoomed in compared with the rest of the desktop.
labels.root_cause: winit scales by the panel's physical DPI reported by XRandR, while the desktop renders at 96 DPI.

labels.symptom: Some menus, tooltips and dialogs stay in English whichever interface language is chosen.
labels.root_cause: Interface strings were drawn directly instead of being looked up in the translation catalog.

labels.symptom: Drawn icon buttons switch state instantly and some show no pressed feedback.
labels.root_cause: The drawn icon buttons had no hover fade and no pressed state.

labels.symptom: You can't draw freehand ink with a pen, pencil or highlighter.
With the System theme, the interface stops following later OS light/dark changes.
labels.root_cause: Calling ctx.set_theme with a fixed Light or Dark value makes egui-winit set an explicit NSAppearance, so the OS ThemeChanged events stop arriving.

labels.symptom: There is no way to insert icons from a searchable library.
Several features that were reported as merged were missing because their squash merges came out empty.
labels.root_cause: A tooling error squash-merged six PRs as empty commits.

labels.symptom: On Windows PCs whose graphics lack a DirectX 12 driver the app is very laggy because it renders in software.
labels.root_cause: Only the DX12 backend was enabled, so GPUs without DX12 drivers fell back to the WARP CPU renderer instead of using OpenGL.

labels.symptom: There are no Tabs or Borders and Shading dialogs.
Long display equations run off the page instead of wrapping onto the next line.
labels.root_cause: Layout had no line breaking for display equations.

labels.symptom: There are no Switch Windows, Arrange All or Side by Side commands.
Charts, SmartArt and embedded objects are silently lost when a document is saved.
labels.root_cause: The DOCX writer skipped graphic objects, and OLE objects were read as their picture only.

labels.symptom: There are no Columns, Symbol or Field dialogs.
Many of the reference app's common keyboard shortcuts are missing.
Pictures, shapes and text boxes can't be rotated or flipped freely.
Mail merge cannot use Excel or OpenDocument spreadsheets as recipient lists.
The Define New Multilevel List and Track Changes Options dialogs are missing.
The product website link in the README and the MCP server info returns HTTP 404.
labels.root_cause: The app has no product page on getartcraft.com yet.

labels.symptom: There is no Polish interface, and Polish text is flagged as English misspellings.
Some equation templates show only the first letter of a multi-letter operand.
labels.root_cause: Template operands were not grouped in the linear format.

labels.symptom: A test fails on CI machines with no fonts installed, because the expected glyph is substituted.
labels.root_cause: The test assumed a math font is present.

labels.symptom: Fields can't show their codes or be edited, unlinked, locked or stepped through.
The user name set in Options goes back to the default after a restart.
labels.root_cause: The author name lived in the session and was not included in the saved UI preferences.

labels.symptom: There are no keyboard commands to move paragraphs, promote or demote headings, go back to earlier edits, or toggle Unicode with Alt+X.
labels.root_cause: The commands were not implemented.

labels.symptom: Multi-column text before a continuous section break fills the first column instead of balancing.
labels.root_cause: Layout did not balance columns on the last page of a section.

labels.symptom: Opening certain Markdown or HTML files hangs the app for tens of seconds.
labels.root_cause: Unmatched brackets and stray ampersands caused the parser to rescan the rest of the text, taking quadratic time.

labels.symptom: There is no way to insert a drawing canvas that holds shapes, pictures and text boxes.
Long footnotes push their reference line to the next page instead of continuing there.
labels.root_cause: Footnotes could not be split across pages.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+- / Ctrl+= / Ctrl+0 zoom the whole window and also trigger the app's own shortcut, e.g. deleting selected text.
labels.root_cause: egui's built-in keyboard zoom shortcuts were left enabled and conflicted with app shortcuts.

labels.symptom: Tight and Through text wrapping act like Square wrapping around the bounding box.
A document's own footnote separator lines and continuation notice are lost on screen, in PDF and on save.
labels.root_cause: The DOCX reader dropped the special separator, continuationSeparator and continuationNotice notes.

labels.symptom: A small crafted document with many namespace declarations uses gigabytes of memory and the app can be killed for running out of memory.
labels.root_cause: quick-xml before 0.41 stores namespace declarations without a limit (RUSTSEC-2026-0195).

labels.symptom: Text always wraps on both sides of a floating object; there is no way to choose a wrap side.
Right-to-left tables and section columns are laid out left to right.
labels.root_cause: w:bidiVisual and section w:bidi were not laid out.

labels.symptom: Opening and saving a document replaces the Hebrew or complex-script size, bold and italic with the Latin formatting.
labels.root_cause: Complex-script properties were merged with Latin properties during inheritance and DOCX reading and writing.

labels.symptom: Typing a font name in the font box doesn't find matching fonts; you must pick from the list.
labels.root_cause: The font box had no type-ahead search.

labels.symptom: Bullets that use the Symbol or Wingdings font show as a wrong glyph when that font is not installed.
labels.root_cause: Private-use code points were drawn with a substitute font instead of being mapped to Unicode.

labels.symptom: Rotated or flipped embedded objects lose their rotation after saving to .docx.
labels.root_cause: OLE write-back markup did not include rotation and flip attributes.

labels.symptom: Status docs contain duplicated rows after parallel merges.
labels.root_cause: Overlapping PR merges duplicated rows in the docs.

labels.symptom: Keyboard shortcuts cannot be customized or reassigned.
The window's size and position are not remembered between launches.
labels.root_cause: Window geometry was never saved or restored.

labels.symptom: Text boxes lack text direction, vertical alignment and linked text flow.
There is no Templates and Add-ins dialog to attach a template or update styles.
The Quick Access Toolbar's customize (…) button does nothing, and the ribbon can't be customized.
labels.root_cause: Ribbon and Quick Access Toolbar customization was not implemented.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Czech.
labels.root_cause: There was no Czech translation catalog.

labels.symptom: Only four citation and bibliography styles are available.
A drop cap in text larger than 1000 pt crashes the app and PDF export.
labels.root_cause: f32::clamp was called with min greater than max.

labels.symptom: Footnote and endnote options cannot be set per section.
Content controls in documents are lost when a file is opened and saved again.
labels.root_cause: w:sdt elements are unwrapped on read.

labels.symptom: Documents with extreme page-number starts crash, or a wave border with huge spacing uses up all memory.
labels.root_cause: Page and line number additions could overflow u32, and the wave stroke loop stopped advancing at very large coordinates.

labels.symptom: No Linux riscv64 release download is offered.
Alt text can only be set on pictures, objects cannot be marked as decorative, and the accessibility checker has few rules.
Deleting a column after deleting cells can leave an empty table with no rows.
labels.root_cause: del_col kept the table block after its last row was removed.

labels.symptom: Arabic documents lose right-to-left table and section layout, Arabic numbering and correct PDF text mapping.
Formatting changes are not tracked as revisions, and opening then saving a file drops existing formatting revisions.
labels.root_cause: The DOCX reader and writer and the document model had no support for w:rPrChange and w:pPrChange.

labels.symptom: Document grid settings for lines per page and characters per line are not supported, so CJK documents lose their page layout.
labels.root_cause: The w:docGrid section property was not modelled or used in layout.

labels.symptom: Tracked moves are opened and saved as a plain deletion plus insertion.
In the web version, a page that embeds the editor in an iframe cannot open documents in it or store saves, so Save and Export only download.
The Draw tab has no Lasso Select, custom pens, Ink to Shape or Ink Replay.
The Caption, Index, Table of Contents and Create Source dialogs are missing, and a table of contents ignores the requested heading depth.
The translation audit misses untranslated controls in the bottom row of ribbon groups and controls past the window's edge.
labels.root_cause: The audit swept a fixed y band in a narrow window and reused state between clicks.

labels.symptom: The Line Numbers, Hyphenation, Language, Envelopes and Labels dialogs are missing.
Charts cannot be inserted or edited in documents.
Adds Alt-key ribbon keytips, a selection mini-toolbar, a ribbon overflow button and macOS typography.
After a hyperlink is inserted, text typed above or below it also becomes part of the link.
labels.root_cause: The hyperlink property was also applied to paragraph marks and carried into new paragraphs.

labels.symptom: Text boxes can be inserted but the caret never lands inside them, so no text can be typed into them.
labels.root_cause: Caret placement and hit-testing ignored text box stories, and pasted boxes shared the original box's story.

labels.symptom: Grouping, resizing or ungrouping rotated shapes changes their orientation or size, and a rotated ink stroke is erased at its old position.
labels.root_cause: Group reset member rotation, Size ignored groups, and erase hit-testing ignored rotation.

labels.symptom: The Compare, Restrict Editing and AutoCorrect Options dialogs are missing.
Paragraph formatting reaches past the selection, undo merges separate steps, and Change Case breaks the selection or formatting.
labels.root_cause: Paragraph range included the end paragraph at offset 0, the typing undo group was not closed on select commands, and byte offsets were wrong after case changes.

labels.symptom: Mail merge ignores SKIPIF and NEXT rules, leaves IF results blank in preview, and leaves header and footer fields unresolved.
labels.root_cause: The merge evaluator skipped conditions and had no record cursor or header/footer handling.

labels.symptom: Several editing bugs: Reject All leaves tracked paste breaks, plain paste drops blank list paragraphs, Replace All ignores paragraph marks, table column delete and cell split act on the wrong cells, and the Font dialog removes formatting you didn't touch.
labels.root_cause: Paste did not mark paragraph marks as tracked insertions, plain paste went through Enter-style splitting, and the table and Font dialog commands handled the selection and existing formatting wrongly.

labels.symptom: Interface text is smaller than the rest of the desktop and there is no setting to enlarge it.
labels.root_cause: Interface font sizes are fixed constants in the theme and there is no user zoom factor.

labels.symptom: WordArt text effects, transforms and shape connectors are missing.
Importing or exporting TXT, RTF, ODT, HTML and LaTeX documents loses text encoding, list labels, styles, colours or spacing.
labels.root_cause: Several separate format-converter bugs, such as TXT bypassing the format crate's decoder.

labels.symptom: In exported PDFs, footnotes in table cells go missing, body page totals show 1 and bookmark links jump to the wrong page; DOCX round trips also lose bookmark ends and INCLUDEPICTURE pictures.
labels.root_cause: Table placement doesn't collect footnotes, and the body is laid out before page totals are known.

labels.symptom: Opening legacy .doc files loses bold, section break types, orientation, lists, style inheritance or fonts.
labels.root_cause: Several binary DOC fields were decoded in ways that do not match the MS-DOC specification.

labels.symptom: Editing equations deletes rows, loses colours, skips undo, or drops spaces in LaTeX text.
labels.root_cause: Several equation command bugs: renumbering rebuilt from the first row only, and caret moves cleared the retained OMML.

labels.symptom: Screen readers can't read or follow the text on the main document canvas.
labels.root_cause: The custom-drawn canvas is a single opaque egui widget with no AccessKit child nodes.

labels.symptom: Page layout errors: mirrored margins are ignored, tall headers and footers overlap the body text, long endnotes are cut off, and the footnote caret disappears.
labels.root_cause: The layout engine ignored mirror_margins and did not reserve space for tall headers and footers or flow notes onto continuation pages.

labels.symptom: File > Options is one short page, without the setting panes users expect.
The interface cannot be shown in Turkish, and command search does not fold Turkish İ/ı correctly.
labels.root_cause: There was no Turkish catalog, and case folding did not follow Turkish rules.

labels.symptom: With the interface set to Simplified or Traditional Chinese, some characters show as boxes or question marks.
labels.root_cause: The font fallback chain had only a Japanese CJK face with no system CJK fallback, and PingFang wasn't found on macOS 12.

labels.symptom: Sections set to vertical text direction are laid out horizontally.
There is no Outline view with heading levels, collapse/expand and Show Level.
labels.root_cause: Outline view mode was not implemented.

labels.symptom: On Windows with AMD graphics, the app flashes briefly and exits with no window or error.
labels.root_cause: The default wgpu instance also starts the OpenGL backend, which crashes inside AMD's OpenGL driver.

labels.symptom: Toolbar icons are drawn in inconsistent styles.
There is no option to show digits as Arabic, Hindi, context or system numerals.
SmartArt graphics cannot be created or edited.
A fixed-width side panel shows a resize cursor and line on its edge, but dragging it does nothing.
labels.root_cause: egui panels are resizable by default, so a panel set with exact_size still drew a resize handle.

labels.symptom: Installed Chinese fonts don't appear under their Chinese names in the font list, and documents naming fonts in Chinese fall back to another font.
labels.root_cause: The font database reads only the English family name of each font.

labels.symptom: Piping CLI output into a reader that closes early, such as head, makes the CLI panic with a Broken pipe error and exit 101.
labels.root_cause: The CLI wrote with println!, which panics on EPIPE because Rust ignores SIGPIPE.

labels.symptom: Switching tabs in a dialog makes the window re-centre, so the title bar and tab strip jump up and down.
labels.root_cause: Dialog windows are anchored CENTER_CENTER, and egui re-applies the anchor every frame as the height changes.

labels.symptom: In Spanish, the Page Up and Page Down labels are swapped and instructions mix formal and informal forms of address.
labels.root_cause: Errors and inconsistencies in the Spanish catalog.

labels.symptom: The Paragraph dialog lacks Mirror indents, same-style spacing, Suppress line numbers and Don't hyphenate.
The table of contents shows wrong page numbers, and Word treats a saved TOC as plain text.
labels.root_cause: The TOC update read pages from the wrong layout, and the writer placed the field outside the entries.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking a picture or shape offers no Wrap Text options.
labels.root_cause: The object context menu had no text wrapping submenu and right-click did not select the object.

labels.symptom: The spell checker flags common modern words such as "desktop" as misspelled.
labels.root_cause: The dictionary is an old word list with too small a supplement.

labels.symptom: Inline content controls in DOCX files are lost on round trip.
labels.root_cause: The DOCX reader and writer did not keep inline content-control properties.

labels.symptom: The app inside the macOS DMG fails strict code signature verification.
labels.root_cause: hdiutil makehybrid -hfs adds com.apple.FinderInfo to every file in the image, and strict codesign rejects it.

labels.symptom: Only one document can be open at a time, and open documents are not restored on relaunch.
Documents with footnotes saved as .docx fail to open in LibreOffice.
labels.root_cause: The docx writer emitted a footnoteReference to the note itself inside the note body in addition to the footnoteRef mark.

labels.symptom: PR CI takes 30-50 minutes because slow FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 jobs run on almost every PR.
labels.root_cause: These workflows were triggered by lockfile changes and by pushes to main.

labels.symptom: Bibliography sources are lost when DOCX files are saved.
The Font dialog cannot set separate fonts for Asian and Latin text.
After reopening a saved document, updating a one-entry table of contents duplicates the entry or keeps an obsolete one.
labels.root_cause: The DOCX reader left the TOC field marker on the entry paragraph instead of at the field separator.

labels.symptom: On macOS clicking the red window close button crashes the app instead of quitting cleanly.
labels.root_cause: The window was dropped inside the AppKit event loop on close, which aborted; quitting is not deferred to the next main-queue turn the way Command-Q is.

labels.symptom: The floating text toolbar is clipped, dropdown arrows look like dots and the font list has white backgrounds in dark mode.
labels.root_cause: Fixed toolbar width smaller than its controls and a tiny dropdown icon.

labels.symptom: Arch Linux users have no AUR package to install the app.
Only a few shapes are available and shapes cannot be drawn by dragging on the canvas.
AutoCorrect does not fix two initial capitals or accidental Caps Lock, and does not capitalise table cells.
AutoFormat as you type does not handle +---+ tables, arrow bullets, smileys inside words, or undo after a border line.
Chinese documents lose first-line indents, floating tables overlap earlier pages and blank pages appear.
labels.root_cause: sprmPDxaLeft1 operand read as four bytes instead of two, and floating table/page-break pagination errors.

labels.symptom: Find and Replace treats ^p, ^t and wildcards as literal text.
Find Next in the Find dialog skips every other match.
labels.root_cause: The dialog ran find and then findNext on each click, moving two matches.

labels.symptom: Legacy .doc files open without their pictures and drawings.
labels.root_cause: The binary .doc reader skipped OfficeArt drawing records.

labels.symptom: Word XML (Flat OPC) and Word 2003 XML documents cannot be opened or saved.
labels.root_cause: No reader or writer existed for the Flat OPC and WordprocessingML 2003 formats.

labels.symptom: Chinese-numbered lists show digits or wrong characters instead of 一、二、三.
labels.root_cause: chineseCounting fell back to decimal, and all label glyphs were drawn with the face of the last font run.

labels.symptom: Update to Match Selection does not change the style, and the selection loses its formatting.
labels.root_cause: Only direct formatting was copied to the style, and the style was not applied to the selection.

labels.symptom: Clicking the Page Setup group launcher in the Layout ribbon tab does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The launcher called ui.dialog with empty params, so no dialog name was resolved.

labels.symptom: Clicking OK in the Paragraph dialog replaces Exactly or At Least line spacing with Single.
labels.root_cause: apply_paragraph always sends lineSpacing as a multiple, even when the value did not change.

labels.symptom: Adds a contributor entry.
CJK text mixes serif and sans glyphs within one word when fallback fonts are used.
labels.root_cause: Per-character fallback picks the first covering face in load order, so different characters in one run land on different faces.

labels.symptom: Paragraphs with contextual spacing show too large a gap compared with Word.
labels.root_cause: The previous paragraph's space-after was not subtracted, and the contextual flag was not tracked per paragraph.

labels.symptom: The text caret jumps instantly and blinks on and off rather than gliding and fading.
No Indonesian translation is available for the interface.
Reopening the Font dialog always shows 0 character spacing and effects turned off, even though they were applied.
labels.root_cause: The format state query did not report spacing or effects, and the dialog hardcoded defaults.

labels.symptom: The interface cannot be shown in German.
Paragraph spacing inside table cells of legacy documents is lost when they are opened or saved.
labels.root_cause: The allowSpaceOfSameStyleInTable compatibility flag was not preserved or honored in layout.

labels.symptom: While typing with an input method, composition text in scripts like Bangla shows as empty boxes.
labels.root_cause: Composition text was drawn with the interface fonts, which have no glyphs for those scripts and no fallback.

labels.symptom: In the web app, after a CSV is picked as a recipient list, the next dropped TXT document replaces the recipients instead of opening.
labels.root_cause: drain_inbox read the recipient-pending flag only for .txt files, so after a CSV was picked the flag stayed set.

labels.symptom: A pending citation is inserted into a new document that replaced the original one.
labels.root_cause: The Zotero link did not check which document a command started in.

labels.symptom: Moving a citation out of a footnote deletes a picture that was in the same note.
labels.root_cause: remove_empty_note judged a note empty by looking only at its text.

labels.symptom: On Linux desktops without a portal file chooser or zenity, Open, Save and Import do nothing at all.
labels.root_cause: rfd returns None both on cancel and when neither the xdg portal FileChooser nor zenity is available, so the failure is silent.

labels.symptom: Unsaved work is lost when the app crashes.
labels.root_cause: There was no autosave or crash recovery snapshot.

labels.symptom: The options only offer a light/dark mode switch, with no separate light and dark theme picker.
Pictures in headers and footers cannot be moved, resized or rotated.
labels.root_cause: Hit testing and object handles only worked on the body.

labels.symptom: Saving a DOCX drops native Word ink or flattens it to a picture.
labels.root_cause: The DOCX writer did not keep w14:contentPart InkML parts.

labels.symptom: Paste from the menu or context menu ignores text copied in other programs, though Ctrl+V works.
labels.root_cause: Menu paste sends no text and only pastes the app's internal clipboard, never reading the system clipboard.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Italian.
labels.root_cause: There was no Italian translation catalog.

labels.symptom: The About window doesn't credit contributors or models.
There is no way to put a border around characters.
Table columns and rows cannot be resized by dragging their borders.
Large list labels make line spacing much taller than in Word.
labels.root_cause: The label's full height was added instead of only its ascent overflow beyond the scaled text pitch.

labels.symptom: No AI writing suggestions for rewriting, continuing or summarizing text.
On Windows the app exits right after the window appears with 'Parent device is lost'.
labels.root_cause: wgpu's default DX12 shader compiler loads an unrelated dxcompiler.dll without a matching dxil.dll, so shader compilation fails and the device is lost.

labels.symptom: Opening a document with many distinct characters that no loaded font covers freezes the app for a long time.
labels.root_cause: The system font fallback re-reads and parses every system font file for each distinct uncovered character.

labels.symptom: Saving a DOCX drops its custom XML data stores.
labels.root_cause: Custom XML parts are not kept through the package graph on export.

labels.symptom: Users on Arch do not know which AUR package to install.
labels.root_cause: The README did not cover the AUR packages.

labels.symptom: Saving an imported document loses the field boundaries of a table of contents that doesn't use the built-in TOC styles.
labels.root_cause: TOC import recognised only styled result ranges and normalised them in a way that drops the original extent.

labels.symptom: After dragging a ruler indent marker, undo moves it back one small step at a time instead of to the start of the drag.
labels.root_cause: Each drag frame ran a mutating command that took its own undo checkpoint.

labels.symptom: Saving can overwrite or delete an unrelated file, or corrupt the original through a link, and a failed save leaves a temporary file behind.
labels.root_cause: Saves write to a predictable '<document>.tmp' path that isn't created exclusively, so an existing file, directory or symlink at that path gets clobbered or followed.

labels.symptom: Dragging an inline picture switches it to square wrapping, and the shapes and fill options are limited.
Imported documents show fixed colours and fonts instead of the document theme's colours and fonts.
labels.root_cause: The DOCX reader preferred fixed values over themeColor and asciiTheme attributes.

labels.symptom: An inserted table has no move handle, so it cannot be selected or moved with the mouse.
CI workflows are duplicated in every repo and raise Node 20 deprecation warnings.
Saving a DOCX changes its paragraph spacing when you reopen it in Word.
labels.root_cause: Saving wrote an empty pPrDefault container even when the original file left it out.

labels.symptom: Opening a text file with an unfamiliar extension such as .m3u or .log fails with an unsupported format error.
labels.root_cause: Files were opened by extension only, and their contents were never checked.

labels.symptom: Dragging after a double- or triple-click doesn't extend the selection by whole words or paragraphs.
labels.root_cause: egui reports multi-clicks only on release, so drag-by-unit selection wasn't possible.

labels.symptom: A layout test fails on Linux machines without a particular font installed.
labels.root_cause: The test assumed pagination that depends on installed fallback font metrics.

labels.symptom: The list toolbar buttons never show as active when the cursor is inside a list.
labels.root_cause: The ribbon didn't query the paragraph's list state.

labels.symptom: Myanmar, Khmer and Indic text is drawn with broken shaping, in a heavy font weight, and does not wrap.
labels.root_cause: Each run was shaped as the script of its first letter, and font fallback chose the wrong font face.

labels.symptom: Colour pickers only offer preset colours, with no custom colour or hex input.
labels.root_cause: There is no custom colour dialog.

labels.symptom: Comments are missing from printed, exported and converted copies of a document.
Fonts can't be added at run time; they are available only if bundled or installed on the system.
Vertically merged table cells still show an inner gridline and respond to clicks as two cells.
labels.root_cause: Table layout placed a cell box per row for continuation cells, and those boxes were drawn and hit-tested separately.

labels.symptom: Diagrams in DOCX files are missing lines, arrows and callout outlines.
labels.root_cause: Theme style references, arrowheads, connectors, drawing canvases and VML lines were not read or drawn.

labels.symptom: There is no way to check spelling and grammar with a LanguageTool server.
In the ribbon's Design tab, the style set gallery overlaps the Colors and Fonts controls.
labels.root_cause: The gallery drew straight into the ribbon row without its own allocated box or spacing.

labels.symptom: File > Print has no preview and no way to choose a page range, number of copies or collation.
labels.root_cause: The print action always exported the whole document with no print settings.

labels.symptom: Typing in very long documents re-lays out the whole document on every keystroke.
labels.root_cause: Pagination placed every block again after each edit.

labels.symptom: Documents that use Palatino Linotype or Book Antiqua fall back to a generic serif font even when Palatino is installed.
labels.root_cause: The font substitution table mapped these fonts to the generic serif list.

labels.symptom: Render and screenshot commands from the automation control channel write PNGs to fixed names in the shared temp folder, where another local user can plant a symlink.
labels.root_cause: The control server writes to a fixed /tmp path with std::fs::write when no path is given, and also writes unsafe link schemes such as javascript: into exported href attributes.

labels.symptom: The brand licence file names a different Craft app instead of this one.
labels.root_cause: The brand licence was copied from a sibling repo without changing the app name.

labels.symptom: Building the docs with warnings treated as errors fails because public docs link to private items.
labels.root_cause: Doc comments in the UI crate use intra-doc links to private constants (rustdoc::private_intra_doc_links).

labels.symptom: You can't hide the white space between pages in Print Layout, so long documents are tiring to edit.
labels.root_cause: No hide-white-space command or view state existed.

labels.symptom: After a toolbar button is clicked, the document canvas loses keyboard focus and typing stops until the user clicks back in.
labels.root_cause: Toolbar buttons kept keyboard focus and did not hand it back to the canvas.

labels.symptom: The bullets and numbering toolbar buttons do not look active when the cursor is in a list.
labels.root_cause: The ribbon had no paragraph list state to decide the button's checked state.

labels.symptom: A web page can send commands to the local automation port through an HTTP request.
labels.root_cause: The control server kept reading after non-JSON lines, and hyperlinks allowed any URL scheme.

labels.symptom: Table of contents fields are written so that Word can't find the TOC or LibreOffice splits the heading.
labels.root_cause: The TOC field begin and end markers were placed wrongly in the written document.

labels.symptom: Running the tests reads the sample document aloud on macOS.
labels.root_cause: A fuzz test ran the readAloud command, which spawns the say command.

labels.symptom: A restored window can open off-screen because the off-screen check was skipped.
labels.root_cause: The saved window geometry was used on the first frame, before the monitor size was known, so the off-screen rescue never ran.

labels.symptom: Page breaks are lost on export, and words on either side get joined together.
labels.root_cause: The shared flow model dropped the U+000C page break character.

labels.symptom: A numbered list right after a bulleted list exports as bullets or keeps counting from the earlier list.
labels.root_cause: Exporters grouped consecutive list paragraphs into one list without checking whether the list kind changed.

labels.symptom: Opening the font dropdown freezes the app.
labels.root_cause: The font preview code called ui.input while holding egui's context write lock in data_mut, deadlocking.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Ukrainian.
Replace All with Track Changes on makes edits that are not tracked.
labels.root_cause: Replace All edited text directly instead of going through the tracked typing path.
